name: services/mailing/send_simple_by_template
description:
Send multiple messages using a template.

This method calls send_simple_message multiple times, each time with different contents, derived from a given simple template. All messages will be from the "USOS Notifier" address.
brief_description: Send multiple messages using a template.

arguments.name: subject_template
arguments.description:
Subject of the message, might include template placeholders (see below).
	The length of each subject (after template substitution) might not exceed
	200 characters.

arguments.name: content_template
arguments.description:
Content of the message, might include template placeholders. The length of each message content (after template substitution) might not exceed 15000 characters.

Template placeholders are substrings in a form of {var_name}. Such strings will be replaced with the content of the var_name variable, which you will provide below (recipients argument).

Keep in mind, that in order to use curly braces signs in your templates, you will need to escape them with one more curly brace ("{{" and "}}"). See here for more info on Python format strings.

arguments.name: recipients
arguments.description:
JSON-formatted, UTF-8 encoded list of dictionaries. Each dictionary represents one recipient and has the following structure:

  • email - email address of the recipient,
  • vars - a dictionary of template placeholder substitutions for this recipient (var_name -> replacement).

arguments.name: from_name
arguments.description: Name to be inserted into the From header (no more than 100 characters).

arguments.name: from_email
arguments.description: Email to be inserted into the From header (no more than 100 characters). Valid only is passed along the from_name argument. If not given, this will be a default no-reply address.

arguments.name: send_summary_to
arguments.description:
Email address. If given, USOS API will send a summary report to this address.
	This report will contain any errors USOS API encountered while
	sending the message. Original message content and recipients might be included.
	These reports might be split in several parts.

arguments.name: lang
arguments.description: Either pl or en - the language, in which USOS API will generate headers and signatures that might be added to your message prior to the sending. This will also be the language in which the optional summary report will be generated.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list of message IDs generated for your messages (one for each of the recipients).
